notes.zh: 修复邮箱错误被通用文件权限提示隐藏的问题。显示脱敏的服务器响应、连接阶段及异常类型，支持复制；登录后重新协商IMAP能力并发送客户端标识，改善163兼容。
notes.en: Shows sanitized mailbox server responses, connection stages and exception types instead of a generic file-permission error. Refreshes IMAP capabilities after login and sends client identification when supported.

notes.zh: 报告改为Markdown（.md），完整显示标题、加粗、嵌套列表、链接、表格和代码块，兼容旧TXT；新增复制原文及打开报告。含应用内更新、安装失败恢复与中英双语帮助菜单。
notes.en: Reports now use Markdown (.md) with formatted headings, bold, nested lists, links, tables and code blocks, plus legacy TXT compatibility and copy/open actions. Includes in-app updates, rollback and a bilingual Help menu.
